name: Blood-Soaked Soil
disable: DC 18 Diplomacy check or DC 18 Occultism check (trained) to settle the spirits or DC 19 Religion check (trained) to bless the area

items.name: Seep Blood
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the area

---

Effect Blood seeps up from the earth, turning the area into sucking, gory mud. The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 hour. All creatures in or moving through the area must succeed at a DC 16 Reflex save save, or they become Immobilized until they can escape dc=16.

text: The blood of those who died in the area bubbles up from the earth, soaking the soil and turning it into a bloody morass.
